_comment: Оправа лаборатории image-clone: 5 листов по 12 ячеек, прогон 1024x1024, сид 43 на всех стадиях. Сюжеты живёт в queue.json, сюда вкладываются на время генерации.

render.note: R1 = cfg 3.0: первая настройка, при которой текст усиливается, а ветвь негатива жива

variants.name: copy
variants.style: 2D illustration, comic book, hand-painted comic game illustration with visible soft brush strokes, clean dark warm-brown contour line of even thickness around every shape, every shape enclosed by its own closed contour line of even thickness, thinner interior lines of the same hue for muscles, seams and folds, flat local colour kept flat between a few soft-edged form shadows where the figure turns away, matte finish, matte painted surface with fine painterly tonal variation, warm ochre skin, one saturated cold garment colour, brown leather accents, small soft highlights on metal and leather only, shadows tinted warm with the local colour, single soft contact shadow under the boots, heroic stocky build, head about one fifth and a half of the height, huge traps, thick neck, oversized hands, fists read as solid masses, mature stylized face, simplified exaggerated features, blocky nose, small mouth
